meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 lsp 工具调用语言服务器:查看文件诊断、跳转符号定义、查找引用、检索符号,并在重命名前检查该位置是否可改。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作区需要语言服务器的诊断、定义、引用等结果,或要在重命名前做安全检查时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 用 lsp.find_references 找出这个符号在工作区里的所有引用
say.note: 在工作区范围内查找该符号的用法。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude calls language servers through the lsp tools: file diagnostics, go-to-definition, find references, document and workspace symbols, and rename validity checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

say_en.text: Use lsp.diagnostics on this file with severity error
say_en.note: Returns error-level diagnostics for the file.

say_en.text: Use lsp.find_references to list all usages of this symbol
Run lsp.prepare_rename here, then lsp.rename if it's valid
say_en.note: Checks rename validity before applying the edit.
